pageSubtitle: Shortcuts for everyday tasks in your salon dashboard.

addService.title: Add or edit a service
addService.body: Go to Services → Add service. Set name, duration, price, and category. Clients see this on your public booking page.

addStaff.title: Add a staff member
addStaff.body: Open Staff → Add staff. Enter name and contact info, then assign services and working hours so they appear in booking.

salonHours.title: Change salon opening hours
salonHours.body: Salon settings → Operating hours. Set open/close times per weekday. This controls which slots clients can book online.

autoConfirm.title: Auto-confirm new bookings
autoConfirm.body: Salon settings → Basic details: turn on “Auto-confirm new bookings”. When enabled, online bookings are confirmed immediately; when off, they stay pending until you approve them.

calendar.title: Calendar and time off
calendar.body: Use Calendar to see bookings. Block time for breaks, days off, or closures — blocks reduce available slots for clients.

bookingPage.title: Your public booking link
bookingPage.body: Share your salon page so clients book themselves. Open preview below to copy the address from the browser bar.

walkIn.title: Walk-in or phone booking
walkIn.body: From Calendar, create a booking as the owner. Name, phone, and email are optional — if you skip email, the system stores an anonymous client for that visit.
